item: A StyleBro skill: plugin marketplace, bro init --skill, docs
notes: Owner's request 2026-11-04 (docs/decisions/2026-11-04-a-stylebro-skill-for-ai-agents.md): one SKILL.md in plugins/stylebro/skills/stylebro/, served by the Claude Code plugin marketplace (.claude-plugin/marketplace.json), embedded in the tool (`--skill` writes .claude/skills/stylebro/SKILL.md, replaced only when it has bro's marker) and published on the docs site as SKILL.md.
